## On-call handoff — gateway 503s

**Root cause:** dep-4471 (gateway, a.novak, 02:12–02:14 UTC) — "config: connection-per-request for pool isolation." Flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest: false → true` (config gen 118→119). Every request now grabs its own DB connection instead of sharing the pool (size 20) → pool saturates → `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`.

**Impact window:** 2026-03-14 02:14:18 UTC → still ongoing at log end (03:59:27 UTC, last line in `logs/gateway.log`). Not self-healing — queue depth (`waiting=`) climbed from 13 to 74 over that span. `/v1/checkout`, `/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/catalog/search`, `/v1/orders` all affected; `/health` kept returning 200 throughout.

**Blast radius:** gateway only. `logs/worker.log` shows worker's separate DB pool flat (`size=8 in_use=1 idle=7 waiting=0`) unchanged through the whole window — no 503s there, unaffected.

**Rollback:** revert dep-4471 — set `gateway.pool.perRequest` back to `false`. No other deploy is implicated (nearest other one is billing-svc dep-4472 at 02:41, different service, after the incident already started).

Next: roll back dep-4471, confirm `waiting=0` returns in `pool stats` lines.
